title: Viva Glint: customise the Teams survey notifications
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, existing notification controls and licensing requirements are supported, and searches confirmed the stated gaps about the planned editing capability. One minor correction remains: the rollout checklist asks readers to use a notification preview that has no corresponding controls-table row.

claims.quote: Viva Glint admins can now customize the Microsoft Teams notifications sent for surveys.
